class.name: JRPGSelectableList
class.brief_description: A window listing items for the player to choose from, with a cursor, the game's controls and interface sounds.
class.description: Shows [member items] in [member columns] and rows inside a [JRPGWindow], with the skin's cursor on the [member selected] item. The list takes the player's input while it has focus: [code]jrpg_up[/code], [code]jrpg_down[/code], [code]jrpg_left[/code] and [code]jrpg_right[/code] move the cursor (left and right with two columns or more), going round at the ends on a fresh press only, so a held key stops at the end; a held direction repeats [constant REPEAT_DELAY_FRAMES] frames after the press, then every [constant REPEAT_INTERVAL_FRAMES] (at 60 frames a second). [code]jrpg_page_prev[/code] and [code]jrpg_page_next[/code] do what [member page_mode] says (a page of rows by default); [code]jrpg_ok[/code] chooses the item under the cursor ([signal item_chosen]; a disabled item only buzzes, [signal item_refused]); [code]jrpg_cancel[/code] backs out ([signal cancelled]). A key already held when the list gets the focus is neither a press nor a repeat for it until it is released. The viewport's focus keys ([code]ui_focus_next[/code], [code]ui_up[/code] and the like) are taken too, so the focus stays on the list. With the mouse, pointing at an item moves the cursor there, clicking the item under the cursor chooses it (the click that gives the list the focus only moves the cursor), the right button cancels anywhere on the screen while the list has the focus, and the wheel scrolls. Dragging and touch scrolling are not supported yet. The cursor, OK, cancel and buzzer sounds come from the System data of [member JRPGWindow.database], the project's database when none is set. Authority: client. The list only reports what the player picks.

method.name: add_item
method.description: Adds an item at the end: its [param text], whether it is [param enabled], an optional [param icon] and an optional [param right_text] shown on the right (a count or a cost).

method.name: clear_items
method.description: Removes every item; nothing is selected.

method.name: ensure_default_theme
method.description: Adds the list's defaults (item height, column spacing, cursor margins, text colors) to the default theme under the [code skip-lint]JRPGSelectableList[/code] theme type, unless they are there already. Lists call it before reading their theme items.

method.name: get_item_at_position
method.description: Returns the index of the item at [param position], in the list's own coordinates, or [code]-1[/code].

method.name: get_item_count
method.description: Returns how many items the list has.

method.name: get_item_rect
method.description: Returns where the item [param index] is drawn, in the list's own coordinates (rows above [member top_row] are above the content area).

method.name: get_item_text
method.description: Returns the text of the item [param index].

method.name: get_text_width
method.description: Returns the width [param text] takes in an item as the list draws it (control codes for sizes and icons included), without the item's icon, right text and margins.

method.name: is_item_enabled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the item [param index] can be chosen.

method.name: set_item_enabled
method.description: Sets whether the item [param index] can be chosen. Disabled items are drawn dimmed and only buzz when chosen.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], the cancel action and the right mouse button back out of the list with [signal cancelled]; if [code]false[/code], they do nothing.
How many items each row holds.
The items, as dictionaries: [code]text[/code], [code]enabled[/code] (default [code]true[/code]), [code]icon[/code] (a [Texture2D], optional) and [code]right_text[/code] (optional).

What [code]jrpg_page_prev[/code] and [code]jrpg_page_next[/code] do: [constant PAGE_SCROLL] moves a page of rows, [constant PAGE_SIGNAL] emits [signal page_requested] (a menu screen switches actors), [constant PAGE_NONE] leaves them to the screen's own input handling.
The item under the cursor, or [code]-1[/code]. Setting it moves the cursor at once, scrolling to show it, without a sound or a signal.
The first row shown. The list scrolls by itself to keep the cursor in view.

signal.name: cancelled
signal.description: Emitted when the player backs out of the list (cancel, or the right mouse button).

signal.name: cursor_moved
signal.description: Emitted when the player moves the cursor to the item [param index].

signal.name: item_chosen
signal.description: Emitted when the player chooses the enabled item [param index].

signal.name: item_refused
signal.description: Emitted when the player chooses the disabled item [param index]; the buzzer sounds.

signal.name: page_requested
signal.description: Emitted when [member page_mode] is [constant PAGE_SIGNAL] and the player presses a page action: [param direction] is [code]1[/code] for the next page, [code]-1[/code] for the previous one.

constants.constant: The page actions move the view and the cursor by a page of rows.
The page actions emit [signal page_requested]; the list stays as it is.
The page actions are not taken, so they reach the screen's [method Node._unhandled_input].
Frames a direction is held before it repeats.
Frames between repeats while a direction stays held.
The largest size an item's icon is drawn at, in pixels.
The default [theme_item font_size], the same as message windows.

theme_items.theme_item: The color of enabled items' text and icons.
The color of disabled items' text and icons.
The margins of the cursor's nine-slice image, in pixels.
The height of each row, in pixels.
